name: Rootcoil Channels
introDiscord:
Living roots weave together into tunnels beneath the kelp forest.
Rootcoil Eels slip through openings barely wider than their bodies,
appearing from roots that should not connect to one another.
introTwitch:
Living roots weave together into tunnels beneath the kelp forest.
Rootcoil Eels slip through openings barely wider than their bodies,
appearing from roots that should not connect to one another.

rootcoil-channels-approach.prompt:
Three root channels twist ahead. Every few moments the roots flex,
quietly changing the shape of the passages.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp hides a Star Candy cache inside a hollow root.
Shizuki scratched an arrow toward it, then another arrow pointing in the
opposite direction, then wrote:

'Root moved. Not my fault.'

right.message:
A Rootcoil Eel disappears through a hole the width of your wrist.

A second later it emerges from an entirely different wall.

You would like to see the floor plan.

forward.message:
A folded leaf holds restorative sap inside a root alcove. Shizuki's
note reads:

'Safe resting nook.

Was on left yesterday.

Currently forward.

Tomorrow's problem.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the sap where it is. At full health, you can save your energy
for arguing with moving architecture.

rootcoil-channels-depths.prompt:
Moonlit fronds hang through the root ceiling as three tunnels coil over,
under, and possibly through one another.

left.message:
A Rootcoil Eel loops around a living root and disappears.

The root flexes.

The Eel emerges directly behind you.

Show-off.

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer has been completely enclosed by roots.
One root politely lifts when you reach for the latch.

You are choosing to trust this.

forward.message:
One Berry is jammed into the corner of Shizuki's hopelessly outdated
root map.

She wrote:

'MAP STATUS:
Accurate for eleven minutes.
New record.'

rootcoil-channels-threshold.prompt:
Towering kelp gives way to the Heartroot Spiral, where three passages
wind around one enormous ancient root.

left.message:
A tranquil grove pool collects between the roots. Shizuki's note says:

'If route starts rotating, stay in pool until forest finishes whatever
it is doing.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched. The roots are currently behaving, which
feels temporary.

right.message:
A Rootcoil Eel wraps around the passage itself, blending perfectly with
the twisted root until its eyes open.

forward.message:
An offering basket is tucked inside the Heartroot's bark. Star Candies
rest beneath a carved symbol that looks remarkably like a smiling Eel.

boss-antechamber.name: Heartroot Spiral
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The enormous central root begins to unwind.

Something has been curled around it.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Heartroot Spiral twists open one layer at a time.

An immense eel-shaped shadow remains coiled around the oldest root,
unmoving until every smaller Rootcoil has fled.

Then one ancient eye opens.

Use /yes to enter the Spiral or /no to let the old root keep its equally
old tenant.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Heartroot Spiral twists open one layer at a time.

An immense eel-shaped shadow remains coiled around the oldest root,
unmoving until every smaller Rootcoil has fled.

Then one ancient eye opens.

Use !yes to enter the Spiral or !no to let the old root keep its equally
old tenant.
bossRetreatText:
You back away before the Heartroot finishes unwinding. The enormous
coil slowly settles again.

boss.revealText:
The root parts and an ancient eel uncoils from its center.

Elder Rootcoil reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Elder Rootcoil disappears through the ancient root network.

The passages settle.

For now.

Shizuki's map is already wrong again."
